_doc: THE declarative registry of the VIRTUAL mode-lifecycle EVENTS (E-LIFECYCLE-001 / S-LC-02). A SIBLING of .claude/agents/_org/mode-lifecycle.json (the mode→contract keystone, S-LC-01) and a parallel of .claude/agents/_org/sprint-hook-points.json (the sprint agent-attachment registry) — a DISTINCT contract with its own schema string, not the sprint-hook-points schema. These events are VIRTUAL: the Claude harness cannot fire custom hook events, so every row carries harness_fires:false and is emitted as a logged `lifecycle-event` record to paths.eventsFile via scripts/hooks/lib/lifecycle-events.js#emit. The 2 REAL PreToolUse guards (mode-switch preflight, mode:init:gate) are NOT declared here — they are S-LC-03/04. This registry + the logger + the report-only coverage enforcer (scripts/checks/mode-lifecycle-hooks-coverage.js) are the EVENT SPINE only: a single place to declare what fires across the mode lifecycle, with a self-detecting assertion that every declared event has an emitter (or a documented pending-wiring entry).
description: Mode-Lifecycle Hooks — the virtual (logged, not harness-fired) lifecycle-event registry for mode switch / teardown / init / session-end / resume.
harness_fires_note: harness_fires is ALWAYS false in v0.1: the harness fires NONE of these. The boolean is STRUCTURAL (machine-readable), not prose — the coverage enforcer reads it to decide whether to look for a real PreToolUse/PostToolUse harness record (it never does for a virtual event) vs a `lifecycle-events.emit("<event>")` reference + a `lifecycle-event` record in paths.eventsFile.

modes.block: the event marks a point that a future REAL guard (S-LC-03/04) would BLOCK on; as a virtual logged event it is advisory-in-effect this sprint, but the declared intent is block.
modes.advisory: an informational lifecycle waypoint — logged, never blocking.

payload_field_meaning._security: Payloads carry STATUS LABELS only, NEVER values. No secrets, no raw input, no credentials. Provider/turbo/binding fields are status STRINGS (e.g. "ready"|"pending"|"absent"), never the underlying value. The logger (lifecycle-events.js) whitelists to the declared payload_fields and scrubs secret-looking keys/values as defense-in-depth.
payload_field_meaning.mode: the current/active mode (used by session:end / resume events).
payload_field_meaning.existing_team_id: the persistent-team id currently stood up (label).
payload_field_meaning.required_team_id: the persistent-team id the target mode requires (label).
payload_field_meaning.sprint_status: sprint binding STATUS label (present|active|absent), never sprint contents.
payload_field_meaning.provider_tier_state: provider tier readiness STATUS label (ready|degraded|absent) — NEVER a key/credential.
payload_field_meaning.turbo_perms_state: turbo / permissions STATUS label (on|off|scoped) — NEVER the granted scope contents.
payload_field_meaning.dry_run: boolean — true when the lifecycle step is a dry-run.
payload_field_meaning.correlation_id: id tying a sequence of lifecycle events to one switch/init/teardown.

events.when: A /mode:* switch is requested (before any validation).
Preflight validation of a requested mode switch (the seam a REAL guard would block on — S-LC-03).
Before tearing down the outgoing mode's team/state.
Before killing the outgoing mode's persistent team.
After the outgoing persistent team is killed.
Before clearing the mode-state marker (.claude/runtime/mode.json).
Before initializing the incoming target mode (the seam a REAL guard would block on — S-LC-04).
Loading the target mode's policy / lifecycle contract.
Before spawning the target mode's persistent team.
After the target mode's persistent team is spawned.
Verify the required persistent team is stood up and live.
Loading the target mode's dispatch matrix / profile.
Verify the sprint binding is present/active for the target mode.
Verify the epic binding is present/active for the target mode.
Verify the tracker binding (TRACKER.md present + valid) for the target mode.
Verify the required planning artifact is present for the target mode.
Verify provider/tier readiness for the target mode's dispatch budget.
After the target mode is fully initialized.
After the mode switch is complete (the switch sequence closes).
Before session end (teardown decision point for the active mode).
After session end completes.
On session resume, a stale/orphaned persistent team is detected.
On session resume, the mode-state marker is reconciled against the live state.
